title: Seawater Filtration and Preservation for Environmental DNA Metabarcoding
author: Mary McElroy

steps.title: Prepare Peristaltic Pump
steps.instruction: Set up peristaltic pumps while wearing gloves.

substeps.instruction: Secure Masterflex pump tubing into each pump head.
Leave sufficient length on the 'in' side for a 10-cm tubing and filter assembly.
Leave sufficient room on the 'out' side to control water outflow.

steps.title: Assemble Filtration Hardware
steps.instruction: Assemble the tubing and filter for a single sample.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve a new 10-cm piece of tubing with a tubing connector fit to one end from clean storage.
Attach the free end of the connector to the 'in' side of the Masterflex tubing at the pump head.
Open a new Sterivex filter and attach the outlet end to the 10-cm tubing.

steps.title: Prepare and Filter Seawater Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the seawater sample using the pump assembly.

substeps.instruction: Invert a seawater sample a few times and remove the cap.
Submerge the Sterivex capsule into the sample using the Masterflex tubing as a guide (ensure the capsule reaches the bottom of a 1-L wide-mouth Nalgene bottle).
Ensure the Masterflex tubing itself does not make contact with the sample.
Turn on the pump and filter at approximately 100 mL/min (60 rpm), ensuring the filter inlet remains submerged.
Avoid filtering sand, sediment, or large biological material from the bottom of the bottle.
Once filtered or clogged, allow air to evacuate the filter for a few seconds (filtration may take 5 to 30 minutes per 1L).

steps.title: Recover Filter Capsule
steps.instruction: Detach the filter from the pump system.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the pump.
Detach the lower tubing from the Masterflex tubing.
Detach the Sterivex capsule from the tubing.
Discard the 10-cm tubing and tubing connector.

steps.title: Prepare Preservation Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Longmire's buffer in a syringe while wearing clean gloves.

substeps.instruction: Add 30ml Longmire’s buffer to a new 30ml Luer Lok syringe.
If precipitates have formed due to cold temperatures, warm and re-dissolve the solution (e.g., using body heat) before adding to samples.
Set the syringe aside in a clean area away from samples and pump equipment.

steps.title: Preserve Filtered Sample
steps.instruction: Add preservation buffer to the Sterivex capsule.

substeps.instruction: Attach a clean 5-cm tubing to the Luer Lok syringe, avoiding contact with the syringe tip.
Attach the outlet end of the filtered Sterivex capsule to the open end of the 5-cm tubing.
Slowly push the plunger to add ~2.2 ml of Longmire's buffer to the capsule, avoiding air bubbles and overfilling.

steps.title: Seal and Label Capsule
steps.instruction: Seal the capsule and prepare it for storage.

substeps.instruction: Secure the open end of the Sterivex with a Luer Lok cap and detach the tubing and capsule from the syringe.
Secure the other end of the capsule with another cap.
Invert the sealed sample a few times.
Label the capsule and cover with clear tape.

steps.title: Clean and Reset for Next Sample
steps.instruction: Decontaminate equipment and dispose of waste to prevent cross-contamination.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of the 5-cm tubing and return the syringe to a clean area.
Wipe the end of the Masterflex tubing with 10% bleach followed by deionized water.
Change gloves often or spray gloves with 10% bleach and deionized water between samples.
Store preserved samples in a bin or bag away from sterile filtration materials.
